• Created a visualization system for water level data across various river banks in Bangladesh.
  • Worked alongside water resource engineers to translate and convert raw GIS data to show predicted flood warning categories in Google Maps.
  • Worked with the the backend team where we were delegated the tasks of seamlessly storing GIS data in a suitable format in Firebase, and creating a secure channel to pull the data to the frontend on demand.

• Designed and implemented data flows to perform extensive analysis of health data owned by MySoft.
  • Developed and styled a frontend dashboard with fluid and insightful data visualization using AngularJS.
